syncEnabled.title: Sync containers
syncEnabled.description: Sync container names, colours, emoji and site assignments through the Google account the Chrome profile is signed in to. Cookies and site data never sync.

keyStorage.title: Where container keys are kept
keyStorage.description: "memory": each container's cookie-jar key is kept only for the browser session, so closing Chrome signs every container out. "disk": keys are kept in the extension's storage and sign-ins survive restarts.

idleTimeoutMinutes.title: Idle sign-out (minutes)
idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Sign a container out after this many minutes without being used. 15 to 43200.

signOutOnLock.title: Sign out when the computer locks
signOutOnLock.description: Sign every container out when the operating system reports the screen is locked.

stripMicrosoftDeviceHeaders.title: Keep Microsoft device sign-in out of containers
stripMicrosoftDeviceHeaders.description: Remove x-ms-RefreshTokenCredential and x-ms-DeviceCredential from container tabs, so a container can't sign in with this device's own work account. Conditional Access rules that require a compliant device then fail inside containers.

stripDbscHeaders.title: Keep Device Bound Session Credentials out of containers
stripDbscHeaders.description: Remove Sec-Session-Registration and Sec-Session-Challenge in container tabs, so Chrome doesn't bind a container's session to the profile's own cookies.

allowBackupExport.title: Allow backup export
allowBackupExport.description: Allow exporting container names and site assignments to a file.

allowBackupImport.title: Allow backup import
allowBackupImport.description: Allow importing containers and site assignments from a file.
